CREATE TABLE "public"."Category" (
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "photo" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "category_name_not_blank_8e77c20d" CHECK (length(btrim("name")) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "category_slug_format_a1584675" CHECK ("slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."Product" (
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "categoryId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "defaultMaxQuantity" int4,
  "defaultMinQuantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "defaultQuantityStep" int4 NOT NULL,
  "defaultSaleUnit" text NOT NULL,
  "description" text,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "photo" text,
  "slug" text NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "Product_defaultSaleUnit_check_8107ba95" CHECK ("defaultSaleUnit" IN ('PIECE', 'KG', 'L')),
  CONSTRAINT "product_default_max_aligned_to_step_1d898355" CHECK ("defaultMaxQuantity" IS NULL OR "defaultMaxQuantity" % NULLIF("defaultQuantityStep", 0) = 0),
  CONSTRAINT "product_default_max_not_below_min_39cab239" CHECK ("defaultMaxQuantity" IS NULL OR "defaultMaxQuantity" >= "defaultMinQuantity"),
  CONSTRAINT "product_default_min_aligned_to_step_b0b13ee5" CHECK ("defaultMinQuantity" % NULLIF("defaultQuantityStep", 0) = 0),
  CONSTRAINT "product_default_min_positive_c6cf8f9b" CHECK ("defaultMinQuantity" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "product_default_step_positive_88ee7a51" CHECK ("defaultQuantityStep" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "product_name_not_blank_8e77c20d" CHECK (length(btrim("name")) > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "product_slug_format_a1584675" CHECK ("slug" ~ '^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$')
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."StoreProduct" (
  "archivedAt" timestamptz,
  "createdAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" SERIAL NOT NULL,
  "isAvailable" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "maxQuantity" int4,
  "minQuantity" int4 NOT NULL,
  "priceMillimes" int4 NOT NULL,
  "productId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "quantityStep" int4 NOT NULL,
  "saleUnit" text NOT NULL,
  "stockQuantity" int4,
  "storeId" int4 NOT NULL,
  "trackStock" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id"),
  CONSTRAINT "StoreProduct_saleUnit_check_e4ec9d4d" CHECK ("saleUnit" IN ('PIECE', 'KG', 'L')),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_max_aligned_to_step_7a1e96ae" CHECK ("maxQuantity" IS NULL OR "maxQuantity" % NULLIF("quantityStep", 0) = 0),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_max_not_below_min_d677fabe" CHECK ("maxQuantity" IS NULL OR "maxQuantity" >= "minQuantity"),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_min_aligned_to_step_6feb37a8" CHECK ("minQuantity" % NULLIF("quantityStep", 0) = 0),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_min_positive_b981200f" CHECK ("minQuantity" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_price_positive_a55c5a5a" CHECK ("priceMillimes" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_step_positive_904d0517" CHECK ("quantityStep" > 0),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_stock_not_negative_4df0751e" CHECK ("stockQuantity" IS NULL OR "stockQuantity" >= 0),
  CONSTRAINT "store_product_stock_tracking_pairing_108fadc4" CHECK ("trackStock" = ("stockQuantity" IS NOT NULL))
)
